suites.name: ToyFeatureIntent
result: Toy purchase uses sorted quote and waits for matching snapshot grant
Toy retries preserve exact quote and all-owned or cross-kind results block purchase
Feature growth requires exact stage stock visibility and committed snapshot
Feature hidden visibility preserves earned stage and caps never consume stock
Feature full rolled stack is a durable zero-debit refusal with no result

suites.name: HueEatingProof
result: saved receipt waits for exact durable snapshot, then presents once
snapshot can arrive first; unrelated receipt never completes it
wrong recipient, dose, stock, result ID or revision cannot start a bite
reset, capped, empty stock and page-open receipts never arm
cancel, layout or recipient generation replacement retires outstanding presentation
